label: Bible Study
prompt: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the _____ is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
verse: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
note: Jeremiah watched a potter remake a marred pot — and God said, 'That's my people.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Every word of God is _____: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
verse: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
note: Agur's proverb: every word of God is pure, and He is a shield to all who trust Him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage _____ of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
verse: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
note: Revelation's best invitation: blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud _____ be stayed?
verse: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
note: God sets the sea its limits like a parent at a playpen: this far, and no further.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he _____ the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:
verse: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:
note: Daniel's praise after the dream was revealed: God 'changeth the times and the seasons' and removes and sets up kings.
